component: Compose FormatHelper text and structural assertions

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Fresh full one-file56-line human patch read. FormatHelper.assertMessageBodyContent replaces only U+00A0 nonbreaking spaces with ordinary spaces on both actual node text and expected text before comparing them. It does not trim, collapse runs or replace tabs/newlines. This change belongs to the test comparator, not production editor serialization or a universal permission to ignore whitespace. Fixed source retains that exact normalizer and separately checks tags, font, size, color, block names, ordered child counts and unexpected children. assertMessageParagraph delegates to the same structural comparison. The needed paragraph test still distinguishes Enter blocks from Shift+Enter BR structure; this patch does not erase those expectations. All changed hunks and the needed fixed consumer/helper sections were read; no test ran.
title: Compose test text comparison equates only NBSP and ordinary space
